//: Declaration-only build for the ./api (worker) entry. The worker's JS is bundled by worker/vite.config.ts into the flat dist/worker.js, but vite emits no types for it — so `@wolffm/hadoku-craft/api` resolved to a bare .js and every consumer's `tsc --noEmit` failed with TS7016. Declarations go to dist/worker/ (a directory) rather than a flat dist/worker.d.ts because tsc emits one .d.ts per source file and cannot merge them without a bundler; the exports `types` condition points at dist/worker/index.d.ts while `default` stays dist/worker.js — those two paths do not have to share a directory.
